versions.changelog: Everpod described as your own AI agent on an always-on cloud computer; the listing leads with OpenClaw set up and run for you.

Hermes and OpenClaw join the developer pod's install choices, installed for the owner to run themselves; the text tells the OpenClaw pod, set up and run for you, from OpenClaw installed on a developer pod.
OpenCode and Pi join Claude Code and Codex as the developer pod's install choices; the description leads with the developer pod.

The move-onto-a-pod sentence corrected: the skill prepares its owner's move onto a pod (it connects the agent and hands over what to upload), rather than moving the agent itself; the opening and the heading 'Prepare your move onto a pod' say so, matching the API reference and the README.

A developer pod's connection steps in one wording: Tailscale on the device the owner logs in from, signed in to the same account; key expiry switched off in Tailscale's admin console (180 days by default); the login over Tailscale SSH, and a rule that lets the owner in on a network with rules of its own or for a tagged machine.
A developer pod now comes with Claude Code, Codex or both, as its owner chooses when it is started: start_pod takes agents, and the steps say so.

Says that Everpod removes its setup access only once a developer pod has joined its owner's network, its key expiry is off and its owner has logged in, and why key expiry is switched off. Offers a file on this computer for the key, beside the chat.
Starts a developer pod for your owner as well as a new OpenClaw agent, and reads which of its owner's steps to connect it are done. Moving yourself onto a pod is unchanged.

- Initial release of the Everpod skill for managed hosting of OpenClaw AI agents.
- Enables agents to move themselves to a private, always-on cloud pod, or start new agents for their owner.
- Provides clear steps to connect to the owner's Everpod account and manage agent migration, including packing and transferring essential data.
- Supports listing and checking the status of all pods owned, with detailed guidance based on pod status.
- Owners control payments, key management, and agent setup via the Everpod web interface.
